# Family Recipe Book

Some notes before the recipes: this book was compiled over many years of
Sunday dinners. Nothing here is a search-engine test fixture, it just
needs to be real text from a different domain than software engineering
so the second-corpus test proves the engine isn't overfit to the primary
demo corpus.

## Tomato Soup

Simmer chopped tomatoes with garlic, onion and basil for forty minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in cream and season with salt and pepper.
Serve the soup hot with crusty bread on the side.

## Sourdough Bread

Feed the starter the night before baking. Mix flour, water and salt into
the active starter and knead until the dough is smooth and elastic. Let
the dough rise for several hours, shape it, and bake in a hot oven until
the crust is deep golden brown.

## Roast Chicken

Season a whole chicken generously with salt, pepper and herbs. Roast in
a hot oven, basting occasionally, until the skin is crisp and the juices
run clear. Rest the chicken before carving and serve with the pan juices.

## Chocolate Cake

Cream butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Fold in flour and cocoa powder, pour the batter into a cake tin, and bake
until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely before frosting the cake.
